body.name: Primary two-node \(C^2\) Morse class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M^{\mathrm{Morse}}_{2,2,1}(c_0,C_0,K,a_0,J,\Delta_0)=\{\theta\in\mathcal M_{2,2,1}(c_0,C_0,K,a_0,J,\Delta_0):\theta\text{ satisfies Assumption }\mathrm{ass:primary\text{-}morse\text{-}hessian}\}\). The indices are fixed at \(n=2\), \(k=2\), and \(m=1\); membership is justified by the displayed \(C^2\) derivative and Hessian conditions and not by a quantitative-Morse perturbation theorem.
